purpose: Two scripted modules for computing breast DCE-MRI functional tumor volume (FTV). Module 1 identifies the DCE series and early/late phases from a DICOM exam folder. Module 2 lets the user set an ROI and omit regions, shows SER-colorized segmentation and writes a PDF report. Aimed at UCSF/I-SPY/ACRIN-style research workflows.
summary: I read the CMake files, the Module 2 main file, the first third of the Module 1 main file and the gzip helper. I found no sign of malicious behaviour, network exfiltration or text aimed at reviewers. The main concerns are environment related. Both modules pip-install packages at import time with no confirmation. These include opencv-python (non-headless, the catalog's Qt/VTK concern), scikit-image and matplotlib. Module 1 also imports distutils, which is gone in Python 3.12. The code uses hardcoded Windows 7-Zip paths with os.system. It also writes a pickle into the extension install directory and rmtree's a folder in the user's exam directory. The catalog entry tracks the moving `master` branch, and there are no automated tests. License is the Slicer BSD-style text plus a copyright notice.
